ChartConfig.structural.reason: StructuralSpec (break_axis/inset) consumed by scene_build::merge_break_specs + scene_build::build_panel_breaks + scene_build::build_chart_insets (render/scene_build.rs), called from build_scene for EVERY panel (#230-7): merge_break_specs runs once per scene (the same-axis merge is a pure function of the spec), build_panel_breaks runs once per panel (each panel breaks its own plot rect and scale pixel range), and build_chart_insets stays chart-scoped, run only on the reference (first) panel because an inset's clip-path ids are namespaced per inset within one SVG document. Emits break indicators / inset nodes as extra annotations and returns the per-axis BreakResult pairs that remap primary mark pixel coordinates through the broken scale.

ChartConfig.title.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme title block, render/config_apply/mod.rs (pinned by apply_chart_config_title_overrides)

GridAxisSpec.color.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> the target axis's own AxisStyleOverrides.grid.color, consumed by build_grid (render/marks/axis.rs) via AxisLayout; the flat GridConfigSpec.color key remains the both-axes shorthand on the theme, which this axis's slot falls back to when unset (D4, spec §4.3)

GridAxisSpec.dash.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> the target axis's own AxisStyleOverrides.grid.dash, consumed by build_grid (render/marks/axis.rs) via AxisLayout; the flat GridConfigSpec.dash key remains the both-axes shorthand on the theme, which this axis's slot falls back to when unset (D4, spec §4.3)

GridAxisSpec.enabled.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> AxisStyleOverrides.grid.show, resolved against theme.grid.grid by AxesInput::apply_show_defaults and consumed by build_grid's per-axis filter (render/marks/axis.rs). This is the per-axis grid enable F-L07-01/D4 (spec §4.3) exists for: configure_grid(x=True, y=False) now takes effect instead of being dropped whole by the old agreeing-values guard.

GridAxisSpec.opacity.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> the target axis's own AxisStyleOverrides.grid.opacity, consumed by build_grid (render/marks/axis.rs) via AxisLayout; the flat GridConfigSpec.opacity key remains the both-axes shorthand on the theme, which this axis's slot falls back to when unset (D4, spec §4.3)

GridAxisSpec.width.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> the target axis's own AxisStyleOverrides.grid.width, consumed by build_grid (render/marks/axis.rs) via AxisLayout; the flat GridConfigSpec.width key remains the both-axes shorthand on the theme, which this axis's slot falls back to when unset (D4, spec §4.3)

GridConfigSpec.color.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme grid block -> theme.colors.grid_color, render/config_apply/mod.rs — the axis-unspecified BOTH-AXES shorthand; an axis's own GridAxisSpec.color wins for that axis (D4, spec §4.3).

GridConfigSpec.dash.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme grid block -> theme.grid.grid_dash, render/config_apply/mod.rs — the axis-unspecified BOTH-AXES shorthand; an axis's own GridAxisSpec.dash wins for that axis (D4, spec §4.3).

GridConfigSpec.opacity.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme grid block -> theme.grid.grid_opacity, render/config_apply/mod.rs — the axis-unspecified BOTH-AXES shorthand; an axis's own GridAxisSpec.opacity wins for that axis (D4, spec §4.3).

GridConfigSpec.width.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme grid block -> theme.sizes.grid_width, render/config_apply/mod.rs — the axis-unspecified BOTH-AXES shorthand; an axis's own GridAxisSpec.width wins for that axis (D4, spec §4.3).

GridConfigSpec.x.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> prep.axes.x's own AxisStyleOverrides (D4, spec §4.3). Accepts both wire spellings: the historical bare bool (enable-only) and a GridAxisSpec object carrying enable + this axis's gridline style — see the GridAxisSpec.* entries.

GridConfigSpec.y.reason: apply_grid_config_to_axis_inputs (render/config_apply/mod.rs) -> prep.axes.y's own AxisStyleOverrides (D4, spec §4.3). Same two wire spellings as GridConfigSpec.x.

LegendStyleSpec.clip_height.reason: legend_overrides_from_prep -> LegendStyleOpts.clip_height, hard-clips via an SVG clipPath

LegendStyleSpec.columns.reason: per-channel and chart-level both resolve in render/config_apply/mod.rs::apply_legend_cascade_to_theme -> theme.legend.legend_columns, per-channel wins (D7 cascade repair, Task 7).

LegendStyleSpec.direction.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme -> theme.legend.legend_direction, resolved against the per-channel override by layout::legend::resolve_legend_direction and threaded into estimate_legend_size/estimate_legend_size_with_title (sizing) AND layout_colorbar (horizontal gradient bars) — D5, Task 7.

LegendStyleSpec.disabled.reason: LegendStyleSpec::suppressed_by — one predicate read by all three askers: the per-channel color legend over its color > x > y chain (prepare/legend.rs), each size/shape aux block over its own one-element chain (legend_channel_disabled), and chart-level configure_legend (chart_config_legend_disabled). Both spellings (disabled: true, orient="none") resolve field-by-field with the same first-Some rule every other legend field uses.

LegendStyleSpec.format_type.reason: prepare/legend.rs's build_color_legend (colorbar) and build_aux_legends (size legend) both read color_legend.format_type / size_enc.legend.format_type and format via format::format_value_with_spec (spec + format_type aware), the legend half of D8's format_type threading — mirrors the axis half at AxisStyleSpec.label_format_type.

LegendStyleSpec.label_font_size.reason: legend-OWN slot: legend_overrides_from_prep (per-channel) / apply_chart_config_to_legend_overrides (chart-level fill) -> LegendStyleOpts.label_font_size, resolved against the theme in layout_color_legend. No longer writes the shared theme.typography.label_font_size, so a legend knob does not resize axis labels (D7, Task 7).

LegendStyleSpec.label_limit.reason: legend_overrides_from_prep -> LegendStyleOpts.label_limit, truncates with an ellipsis

LegendStyleSpec.orient.reason: per-channel (color > x > y, prepare/legend.rs::per_channel_legend_specs) and chart-level configure_legend both resolve in render/config_apply/mod.rs::apply_legend_cascade_to_theme -> theme.legend.legend_orient, per-channel wins (D7 cascade repair, Task 7). orient="none" is a suppression instead, read at the SAME first-Some precedence by LegendStyleSpec::suppressed_by.

LegendStyleSpec.tickLabels.reason: LegendOverrides.tick_labels — explicit colorbar tick labels (SHAP beeswarm)

LegendStyleSpec.title_font_size.reason: per-channel and chart-level both resolve in render/config_apply/mod.rs::apply_legend_cascade_to_theme -> theme.typography.legend_title_font_size, per-channel wins (D7 cascade repair, Task 7).

LegendStyleSpec.values.reason: colorbar tick-label arm (layout/legend.rs::layout_color_legend) AND the categorical filter+order arm (render/config_apply/mod.rs::apply_legend_values_to_entries, run after the color-config resync); unknown categorical names warn via RenderWarning::LegendValuesUnknown and are skipped (D6/F-L04-05, Task 7).

LegendStyleSpec.zindex.reason: LegendOverrides zindex, coarse draw order relative to marks

PaddingConfigSpec.auto.reason: apply_chart_config_to_theme -> theme.padding.padding_auto -> layout::compute_layout's settle_auto_padding, which solves auto_padding_for_edge_ticks then auto_padding_for_axis_titles against a measured chrome credit and caps the result against the viewport (D10): expands a side with no explicit override to contain a continuous axis's edge-tick-label overhang and/or recenter an overflowing axis title, render/config_apply/mod.rs + layout/mod.rs. Built-in default true end to end (#135) — there is no theme key for this value, so the wire's optional auto only overrides it when the caller sets it; an unmentioned auto leaves the rescue on.
